Novo Nordisk modernizes manufacturing process documents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

Novo Nordisk (Novo) is one of the world’s leading global pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing medicines for chronic diseases such as diabetes and obesity, and delivering them to patients across many countries.

Keeping this documentation current and accurate is a core responsibility of the Manufacturing Technology team within the Tablet area, a responsibility that spans a large and diverse portfolio of controlled documents, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, …
The reasoning layer runs on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale with any framework or model.
Documents are processed through an ingestion pipeline that uses Amazon Bedrock Data Automation for multimodal parsing, orchestrated with AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda .

Figure 1: End-to-end architecture where a query agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore uses Amazon Bedrock for reasoning, embeddings, and reranking, with hybrid retrieval across Amazon OpenSearch Serverless and Amazon Neptune linked by shared document numbers.
OpenSearch provides recall – Hybrid search combines dense vector similarity (Amazon Titan Text Embeddings) with lexical BM25 matching, fused with reciprocal rank fusion.

Navigate the group’s process landscape – Users can move across all three levels of the process taxonomy, spanning roughly four million documents and their many subprocesses through a single assistant that acts as both a search engine and a guide over the documentation, the pro…

Understand relationships between entities and documents – The graph helps users ask how documents, processes, equipment, sites, and products connect, including multi-hop questions that manual search cannot answer.

By combining a curated knowledge graph, hybrid search, and a clarify-before-retrieve agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, the Novo Manufacturing Technology team within the Tablet area built a process-intelligence assistant that is fast where speed helps and grounded where accura…
